simple.meaning: חֲנַנְאֵל (Chănanʼêl) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line and in connection with flocks and in connection with kingship and in connection with priesthood.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Nehemiah, Jeremiah, Zechariah, beginning at Nehemiah 3:1. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, kingship, priesthood, city, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֲנַנְאֵל (H2606) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows חֲנַנְאֵל through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: חֲנַנְאֵל (Chănanʼêl) / H2606 is tracked through Nehemiah 3:1, Nehemiah 12:39, Jeremiah 31:38, Zechariah 14:10. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.
